decisions.reason: This spraying system is very close to the firm's established coating and application know-how, so absorptive capacity is high and management would more likely refine it than withdraw it after only one year.
A low-pressure injection pump fits the firm's core competence in injection and material handling, making it a product the firm can learn from and improve with existing engineering resources.
A material transfer pump line with several models strongly builds on the firm's deep experience in conveying systems and broad portfolio logic, so it is unlikely to be taken off the market quickly.

Fire protection flow monitoring is more adjacent to the firm's traditional equipment base, but it still supports its move toward interoperable and digitalized customer solutions, so management would likely keep it while testing market fit further.
